notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
